providers.name: Google Hotels
providers.summary: Explore a map and compare booking options for a stay. Follow the selected booking link to confirm the room and checkout total.
providers.check: A displayed starting price can change with dates, occupancy, taxes and the booking provider.

providers.name: Booking.com
providers.summary: Compare accommodation, cancellation conditions and room choices. Check whether a signed-in Genius rate applies to the exact stay.
providers.check: Member benefits apply to participating options. Compare the final price with the same room and cancellation terms.

providers.name: Agoda
providers.summary: Check hotel and other accommodation options alongside the official deals page. Some offers depend on an app, account or payment method.
providers.check: Read payment currency, taxes and cancellation conditions. Enter your destination and dates again on Agoda.

providers.name: Expedia
providers.summary: Compare hotel-only prices and any relevant member or package options. Review the official coupon page before checkout.
providers.check: A package price is not a hotel-only comparison. Coupon eligibility can depend on the property and payment option.

providers.name: Hotels.com
providers.summary: Compare the exact room and rate conditions, including any applicable member offer or official coupon.
providers.check: Official coupon instructions distinguish Pay Now from paying at the property. Check the terms for your country and account.

providers.name: Trip.com
providers.summary: Search accommodation and check available hotel promotions. Review whether a voucher must be claimed in an eligible account or app.
providers.check: New-customer and app offers have eligibility rules. Re-enter and confirm your trip on Trip.com.

providers.name: KAYAK
providers.summary: Compare hotel search results from booking providers, then check the supplier that will actually take your payment.
providers.check: A search result is not a reserved room. Confirm the supplier, full cost and cancellation deadline at checkout.

promotions.name: Booking.com Genius
promotions.summary: Check account-based benefits on participating accommodation. This is a member-price programme rather than a universal promo code.
promotions.eligibility: Sign-in, participating stay and account eligibility; compare the final total.

promotions.name: Agoda deals
promotions.summary: Find the provider’s current accommodation deals and promotion terms. Check the live page for any code or claim action.
promotions.eligibility: Destination, dates, app, payment method and offer limits may apply.

promotions.name: Expedia coupons
promotions.summary: Read how eligible coupons are applied at checkout and check the current offers. The page may have no suitable code for your stay.
promotions.eligibility: Read exclusions and eligible payment options before choosing a non-refundable rate.

promotions.name: Hotels.com coupons
promotions.summary: Review official coupon and member-offer information. A code must be accepted for your exact booking before it counts as a saving.
promotions.eligibility: Check Pay Now requirements, excluded properties, regional terms and app restrictions.

promotions.name: Trip.com hotel promotions
promotions.summary: Check current hotel-voucher information and any required claim process in the provider’s app or account.
promotions.eligibility: New-user, app, booking window and travel-date conditions can apply.

promotions.name: Wethrift
promotions.summary: Search for a store or booking brand and review reported codes. Its labels and success reports belong to that service; BuySell.Best has not tested the codes.
promotions.eligibility: Use the merchant’s checkout and terms to establish whether a reported code works.

promotions.name: SimplyCodes — Hotels.com
promotions.summary: Explore reported Hotels.com codes and their history as leads to check, rather than a promise of a working discount.
promotions.eligibility: Country, app, account, property and payment restrictions can invalidate a reported code.

promotions.name: Slickdeals — hotel coupons
promotions.summary: Read hotel-coupon explanations and deal leads, then verify the actual promotion on the booking platform.
promotions.eligibility: Check publication date, expiry, exclusions and the final price after the code is applied.
